integrity: The unrestricted proof and reproducible standard-library enumeration are included; exhaustive finite checks are not substituted for the all-size arguments.
scientific_limitations: Finite binary relational structures interpreting named permutations; the exact C2 invariant requires commutation, and the finite counts require exactly two named generators. Computational verification stops at six points for commuting systems and five for unrestricted permutation pairs. Earlier specialized results may exist; no independent audit.
title: Collision profiles and the sharp counting-variable threshold for finite permutation systems
